newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as investors return.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as investors return.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher as investors returned ending a period of lingering bearishness, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 39.64 points or 2.76 percent at 1,473.84 on a turnover of 238.5 million taka. Of 135 traded issues 105 gained, 25 lost and five unchanged.
"Investors have returned after a series of corrections which threw prices of many scrips to their lowest in several months, said one broker.
Bangladesh Lamps gained 335 taka to 5,732, Pran rose 87 to 960 and Beximco Pharma rose 9.0 to 207.
